tools.name: OpenHands Agent Canvas
tools.role: Developer control center and execution layer for repo-scoped coding agents and automations.
capabilities: run Codex and other ACP-compatible agents
work against mounted GitHub project workspaces
run local, Docker, VM, or cloud agent backends
support scheduled or event-driven engineering automations
tools.notes: Keep OpenHands separate from customer-facing application code. Use it as a development control plane; GitHub remains source of truth.

tools.name: Microsoft TRELLIS.2
tools.role: High-fidelity image-to-3D generation layer for branded assets, product visualization, interactive web models, 3D scene components, and downstream video production.
capabilities: convert a single image into a textured 3D asset
generate PBR material attributes including base color, roughness, metallic, and opacity
generate 512, 1024, and 1536 voxel-resolution assets on supported GPU hardware
use the official Hugging Face TRELLIS.2-4B weights and Microsoft Space
tools.notes: Official local implementation is tested on Linux and requires an NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM. Hugging Face model and Space access were verified on 2026-09-08; Hugging Face Jobs execution requires account compute entitlement/credits.

tools.name: LTX-2.5 Distilled
tools.license: LTX-2.x Community License / gated model terms
tools.role: Fast synchronized audio-video generation layer for cinematic social content, faceless YouTube production, branded short-form video, product spots, and operations/training simulations.
capabilities: run the official LTX-2.5 DistilledPipeline with the 22B distilled transformer
support text-to-video and image-conditioned video workflows through the LTX-2.5 model family
generate dialogue, ambience, motion, and cinematic footage in one production workflow
use DFR as the higher-quality production path when additional compute is justified
use the official gated Hugging Face model and Lightricks Space
tools.notes: The distilled transformer is a component inside the gated Lightricks/LTX-2.5 model repository; there is no separate official LTX-2.5-Distilled repo. The official quick start downloads roughly 66 GiB of required components. Use Hugging Face or cloud GPU execution rather than the current Intel Mac, and review current model license terms before commercial deployment.
